t: Drop-forged from a single piece of premium-grade chrome vanadium (CrV) steel. Robust and wear-resistant, whilst maintaining lightness and dexterity. Alloying chromium enhances wear resistance, extending the trowels working life, while combining vanadium imparts greater toughness whilst maintaining flexibility. Utilising this superior CrV steel, and undergoing further advanced hardening and tempering processes, the blade offers the optimal blend of strength, lightness, rigidity and flexibility. Tang angle and rise ensure a balanced feel, helping to minimise wrist fatigue whilst maximising speed and agility. Durable, soft-grip handle provides a secure grip whilst ensuring day-long comfort. Features replaceable end cap and a soft finger guard that can easily be trimmed off depending on preference.
b: Drop-Forged, Hardened & Tempered Chrome Vanadium Steel Blade
